messages:
ravi: Need a compact, customer-facing checklist for pilot launches that involve tenant isolation + multi-region fallback. Sales wants <1 page. Can someone craft a "go/no-go" list we can hand to AMs? @anna

anna: I'll draft. Keep it 7 bullets: Preconditions, Residency, SLA & cost, Isolation mode, Failover order, Validation tests, Ops controls. Make the language non-technical.

lee: Ops asks: add default soft-spill % (5%), required burst buffer (+30% for 15m), KV-evac P95 <30s, and a 48h burn-in monitoring window. Also include the evacuation runbook summary.

ravi: Draft below. Short, numbered bullets. We can tweak wording after review.

ravi: ```text
Pilot launch checklist (one-pager for AMs):
1) Preconditions: ADP/KMS configured and contract residency flags set; SLA tier chosen (Gold/Silver/Beta)
2) Residency rules: list allowed regions; cross-region fallback requires explicit customer consent and legal sign-off for regulated jurisdictions
3) Isolation mode: Shared / Quarantine / Dedicated 1 (choose and confirm quotas)
4) Failover order (default): safe_model_variant -> local_region -> dedicated_capacity_pool -> degrade_to-stub
5) Default spill settings: soft-spill <=5% (opt-in to increase); burst buffer +30% for 15 minutes
6) Validation tests: 1h live smoke with customer prompt set; 10m simulated 5% cross-region spill; prompt-regression <5%
7) Ops controls & rollback: cost-cap enabled, autoscale burn-rate alert, kill-switch to disable cross-region fallback; rollback triggers: p99 >2x baseline or correctness regression >5%
8) Observability required: token-cost, p50/p90/p99, error-rate, kv-evac-time on dashboard
9) Post-enable steps: 48h burn-in monitoring, documented postmortem if any rollback occurred
```

anna: Sales phrasing tweak: replace "kill-switch" with "immediate disable" in customer-facing docs. Also add an AM-facing line: "Expect a 1-hour maintenance window if migration is required."

lee: Runbook snippet for ops (internal): "evacuate-tenant -> pause new sessions -> drain KV windows -> spin up dedicated variant -> verify warm cache -> re-enable routing". Recommend a dry-run with synthetic traffic before pilot enablement.

legal-bot: Note: For EU/CA regulated customers, cross-region fallback must be opt-in and contractually documented. I'll attach a short clause for AMs to include.

ravi: I'll produce the one-pager and a 1-paragraph customer note explaining tradeoffs (latency variability vs reliability). Target: finalize and publish to pilot-docs tomorrow AM. If no objections, I'll mark as approved. :thumbsup:
